 Weather 
 Today's forecast 
 Get the latest weather updates from the NBC6 meteorologists. 
 By Adam Berg • 
 Published November 7, 2026 • 
 Updated on November 7, 2026 at 6:29 pm 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 NBC6’s Ryan Phillips has your forecast for today, Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026.
 This beautiful weather continues Friday with mostly sunny skies and quite possibly zero raindrops. 
 It will be a touch warm as highs push into the 86-87 degree range, but just seeing the sun is worth it. Winds will be light on Friday, so boat and beach conditions look absolutely perfect. Saturday will be amazing as well. 
 Watch NBC6 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 We may see a few raindrops Sunday as a weak front pushes through but the rain will be spotty… nothing like we've previously seen.
 Looking into next week, the weak front that pushes through late Saturday and early Sunday could work back to the north and bring better chances for rain Tuesday and beyond next week.
 TODAY: Mostly sunny. Rain: 20%. High: 86°.
 FRIDAY: Mostly sunny. Rain: 10%. High: 86°.
